brief:
Settlers opened fire on Palestinians in the western area of Beit Furik, east of Nablus, Eye on Palestine reported. The attack left two people injured. One victim sustained minor bruises and received treatment in an emergency department. The second injured person suffered fractures and bruises from the gunfire.

The shooting occurred in a region where such incidents have become recurring. Beit Furik has witnessed repeated clashes between Palestinian residents and Israeli settlers in recent periods. The circumstances that prompted the gunfire and any broader context surrounding the attack were not immediately detailed in initial accounts of the incident.
